remaining-stage-gaps: P8 remains a prerequisite; this review does not declare P9 or any migration stage complete.
The production Go App does not yet prove integrated Store opening, real projector registration, daemon gRPC projection, and event publication through the final production composition root.
The P4 run is an isolated source-contract comparison with lifespan disabled and no daemon, Agent, automatic connection, chat, or inference; fixture-only routes are not evidence of Agent behavior.
No production database, credentials, chat system, daemon, user data, installation, service deployment, or cutover was exercised.
The retained five-binary Go-only build predates the latest attachment/codec fixes and is not current release evidence; rebuild/package verification remains required for a later release tranche.
Current all-package Go tests/vet and contracts/build results supplied by the coordinator were not reclassified as release evidence by this bounded pass.
The reviewed implementation is still untracked worktree content rather than a committed/released artifact; the hashes in this report pin the exact accepted snapshot.
